external_width_authority.source: Brettell-Horsfield-Munaro-Paesani-Paulusma, IPEC 2020, Bounding the Mim-Width of Hereditary Graph Classes
external_width_authority.theorem8: Elementary (n x n)-wall W_n, n>=7: mimw(W_n)>=sqrt(n)/50.
external_width_authority.lemma2: 1-subdividing one edge does not decrease mim-width.
external_width_authority.consequence: After 1-subdividing every edge, J_n satisfies mimw(J_n)>=mimw(W_n)>=sqrt(n)/50.
external_width_authority.source_observation: The same paper explicitly describes the wall + all-edge 1-subdivision + make A complete to B construction as an unbounded-mim construction.

frozen_family.parameter: n>=7; W_n an elementary (n x n)-wall with bipartition A_n disjoint_union B_n
edges: constant support cycle: s1-s2, s1-p, p-m, m-n0, n0-s2
selection gadget: s2-a1, s2-a2, a1-w, a2-w
every u in A_n union B_n is adjacent to s1
r is complete to A_n union B_n
for every wall edge e=ab with a in A_n,b in B_n, z_e is adjacent to exactly a,b among wall survivors
fix one wall edge e*=a*b* and additionally add r-z_{e*}

source_ancestry_target.lemma10_target: identity after canonical list repartition; residual Y0={w} union Z_n

raw_effect: w leaves residual Y0 because it sees a1,a2 and becomes a 2-list X vertex after Lemma10
every wall survivor remains a 3-list L' vertex
every z_e remains in residual Y0
seed_two_target.final_VI_failure: Y cap N(Y0) contains wall survivors of list L' and r of list L0, so at least two exact 3-list classes survive.

one_sigma_target.old_type: {s1} relative to post-Q seed (all are nonadjacent to p,m,n0,s2)

one_sigma_target.source_Z_capture: every wall survivor lies in source Z(L') because it is nonadjacent to selected a2 carrying color 3 in L'

incidence_target.residual_components: each {z_e} is a singleton connected component of final G[Y0]

p7_proof_plan.Z_simplicial: Every z_e has clique neighborhood after A complete B and r complete A union B (ordinary N(z_e)={a,b}; special N(z*)={a,b,r}); hence Z vertices can occur only as endpoints of an induced path.
p7_proof_plan.twin_reduction: Any induced path on at least four vertices contains at most one vertex from each independent false-twin class, reducing P5/P6 pattern checking to a fixed 10-role graph.
required_fixed_checks: every induced P6 in R has both endpoints outside D={A,B,r}
no induced P5 in R has both endpoints in D
p7_proof_plan.implication: 0/1/2 Z endpoints cannot yield an induced P7 in G.

terminals.PASS_SOURCE_EMBEDDING: All source ancestry, one-sigma, P7-free, extension, seed-two, and unbounded-mim obligations pass for arbitrary n.
terminals.BLOCKED_SYMBOLIC_SOURCE_OBSTRUCTION: Identify the first exact failed source/P7 obligation.

promotion_on_pass.interpretation: The bounded-mim common-layout route cannot be universal; future positive routing must use narrower source-certified subclasses or a non-mim mechanism.
